meta.title: OpenRouter Providers
meta.description: Restricts OpenRouter requests to a configured provider list and quantization cap.

en.cardDesc: Injects the provider list as provider.only / provider.order and the quantization cap as provider.quantizations into OpenRouter model requests. Settings persist to the plugin's own configuration file.
en.loadFailed: Cannot read the current state (Host half unavailable)
en.modeOnlyHint: Requests go out only while a listed provider is available (allow_fallbacks=false); the request fails when none is.
en.modeOrderHint: Providers are tried in list order, falling back to the default OpenRouter routing when none is available (allow_fallbacks=true).
en.providersPlaceholder:
One provider per line, for example:
DeepInfra
Together
en.proxyAuto: Auto: route through the proxy when one is detected
en.proxyHint: When a running billion-context proxy is detected, requests go through its /bili/ entry point and gain context compression; with no proxy detected they go direct, so generation is never broken.
en.proxyInactive: No running proxy detected; requests go direct
en.quantHint: Routes only among providers that support the selected quantization (int4 / int8 / fp8 / fp16, for example).
en.savedEmpty: Saved (empty list: OpenRouter requests carry no provider restriction)
en.summary: Restricts OpenRouter requests to a configured provider list and quantization cap.
